btn_help.componentleveltooltip: What the panel means||Every column, symbol and view explained, with what holding goods costs and what it earns.

derpy_chd_ex_prev.componentleveltooltip: Previous page||Back one page of this view. The tabs below change view.

nav_page.componentleveltooltip: Page||Which page of this view you are on. The arrows either side of it turn the page; the tabs below change the view.

derpy_chd_ex_mode.componentleveltooltip: Next page||Forward one page of this view. The tabs below change view.

ord_side.componentleveltooltip: Buy or sell||Switch this standing order between buying and selling.

ord_cmp.componentleveltooltip: At or below / at or above||Whether the order fires once the price falls to this level, or once it rises to it.

ord_down.componentleveltooltip: Adjust the price||Move the order's target price one step up or down. Prices here always move in fixed steps.

ord_up.componentleveltooltip: Adjust the price||Move the order's target price one step up or down. Prices here always move in fixed steps.

ord_place.componentleveltooltip: Place the order||Stands until the price crosses the level shown, then fills automatically on a later turn.

btn_amt_down.componentleveltooltip: One lot at a time||The button between these cycles the round sizes. Use these to reach the ones in between.

btn_amount.componentleveltooltip: Amount per click||How many lots a Buy or Sell moves, and the size a new standing order is placed at. Cycles 1, 5, 10, 25; the - and + beside it step one lot at a time. A lot is 10 of a commodity, 100 of Armaments or Raw Materials, 5 of a house share.
